title: A fence should stay straight.
hook: A fence should stay straight. The gate should close without dragging.
thesis: Happy Place's own service copy is already great trade writing: a fence should stay straight, the gate should close without dragging, and it should still look good after a few Oregon winters. The content here is curation, not invention: read their words over footage of the work. This post is the human pillar of the brand, the proof that the system describes real work done by real hands.

verified: HPP site copy is specific and trade-credible, including the fence/gate/Oregon winters passage (graph data doc, services section, via SYSTEMS.md section 5).
